effect_description_eng: ＜Digisorption -3＞ (When one of your Digimon would digivolve into this card from your hand, you may suspend 1 of your Digimon to reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 3.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] You may play 1 green level 3 Digimon card from your hand suspended without paying its memory cost.
